identity.title: Protect source layers when input and output are the same

origin.summary: The remaining 2D reconciliation identified a focused gap: direct Tool Preview can target the selected input layer as output, while current validation only warns and the source-preservation acceptance is not yet proven as a user-visible guard.

state.current_summary: Direct Tool Preview rejects same input/output layer names before snapshot or publish; existing separate-layer Preview and Pipeline same-layer Run semantics remain intact. The final focused WPF smoke now exercises both Threshold and Arithmetic collision paths, while theme/DPI/monitor matrix and field boundaries remain outside this slice.

objective.summary: Ensure direct Tool Preview never overwrites the selected input layer when input and output names are equal; reject the collision with a clear Preview failure while preserving the existing explicit separate-layer workflow and Pipeline warning semantics.
constraints: Reuse OpenVisionNativePreviewExecutionBoundary/OpenVisionNativePreviewExecutionController as the existing Preview owner; do not add a new service or global policy.
Keep Pipeline in-place graphs available for the existing run-scoped context contract; do not turn every pipeline warning into a blanket prohibition without separate evidence.
Preserve explicit Preview/Run and layer-routing contracts; no automatic output-layer creation, no silent reroute, and no data mutation.
Do not modify, commit, or push C:\Git\2D\Original.

criteria.text: Single-input and Arithmetic direct Preview reject an input/output name collision before publishing, with a typed/visible Preview failure and no output-layer write.
The existing headless same-layer Run contract proves caller/source bytes remain unchanged and the result remains independently usable; separate-layer execution remains valid.
Focused WPF layer-selection/preview smoke and durable owner/call-path documentation record the changed control state, source-preservation boundary, and unverified themes/DPI/monitor/hardware scope.

context.summary: Existing Preview concurrency, input snapshot, computation, and publish call path.
Existing DisplayManager layer write owner; it clones the result but currently accepts a collision with the input layer.
Existing run-scoped context ownership and same-layer pipeline contract.

evidence.observation: PipelineLayerReferenceInvariantContract passed. The same-layer Main→Main Run produced a result while preserving source bytes and remaining independently writable; validation retained one warning and the existing Arithmetic B execution case passed.

Focused WPF target wpf_layer_selection_same_input_output_guard passed. Main/Main was selected, Preview returned visible NG, HasNativePreviewResult stayed false, PreviewRunCount did not increase, Threshold_Preview was not created, and Main changed pixels were zero. The report and screenshot are from the changed Debug build.

The existing Preview controller checks non-blank input/output collisions before single-input snapshot capture and before Arithmetic source capture; both paths return the existing typed OpenVisionNativePreviewExecutionResult failure and therefore cannot reach the layer publisher.

Focused PipelineViewerScreenshotSmoke Debug build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors after adding the collision target; VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build also completed with 0 errors (pre-existing nullable warnings remain outside this slice).

The rebuilt focused WPF target passed after the arithmetic guard assertion was added. Threshold and Arithmetic Main/Main routes both returned visible NG before publishing; no result/run-count increment or source-pixel change was observed, and no Threshold_Preview layer was created.

events.summary: 2D-037 is resolved after the existing Preview owner gained a fail-closed same-layer guard, the headless source-preservation contract passed, and the focused WPF Main/Main smoke passed. Theme/DPI/monitor/hardware and long-run boundaries remain explicitly outside the slice.
